name: Bench Press

instructions.description: Lie on a bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted firmly on the floor.
Grip the bar evenly, lift it off the rack with straight arms, and position it above the chest.
Lower the bar under control to the mid-chest while keeping the shoulders set back on the bench.
Exhale and press the bar upward until the elbows are extended, then re-rack carefully.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a spotter or safety arms for heavier sets.
Record barbell load excluding or including the bar consistently.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Press from the floor to limit shoulder range and reduce setup complexity.

commentsNotes: Do not bounce the bar off the chest.
